en.headline: Hang Seng Index opens 0.98 percent lower at 23,521
en.dek: The benchmark fell 233 points at the open on Tuesday as tech shares came under pressure, with Baidu sliding after results.
body: Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index opened 232.68 points, or 0.98 percent, lower at 23,521.16 on Tuesday, according to Xinhua and local market reports.

The Hang Seng Tech Index opened down about 1 percent, while the Hang Seng China Enterprises Index also retreated at the open. Among heavyweight stocks, Baidu opened lower after reporting a drop in adjusted profit for the third quarter, while Alibaba and Tencent also traded weaker in early dealing.
Chip-related shares showed mixed performance, with some semiconductor names rising while others remained under pressure. Turnover in the early session was reported at around HK$28 billion.
The index had closed 116 points higher at 23,753 on Monday, ending a three-day decline, on turnover of about HK$174 billion.

zh.headline: 恒生指數低開0.98%報23521點
zh.dek: 大市周二開市跌233點，科技股受壓，百度績後股價向下。
body: 據新華社及本地市場報道，香港恒生指數周二開市報23521.16點，跌232.68點，或0.98%。
恒生科技指數開市跌約1%，國企指數亦向下。重磅股中，百度公布第三季經調整純利下跌後低開，阿里巴巴及騰訊早段亦偏弱。
晶片相關股份表現參差，部分半導體股上升，其他則持續受壓。早段成交約280億港元。
指數周一收升116點，報23753點，結束三日跌勢，全日成交約1741億港元。
